style: Soft painted illustration for a high school civic tool: calm morning and afternoon light, gentle textures, muted greens, warm browns and soft teal, wide open scenes, nothing busy.

assets.name: banner-river
assets.prompt: Wide panoramic landscape: a quiet river trail in early morning light, a dirt path running along a grassy bank, tall trees and soft mist over calm water, a few scattered cans and paper scraps near the reeds, soft painted illustration. The middle of the picture shows the river bend and the path clearly. The trail is empty and peaceful. No people, no animals, no writing.

assets.name: banner-garden
assets.prompt: Wide panoramic scene: an empty grassy lot beside a small red brick library building, a chain-link fence along the edge, warm afternoon sun and long soft shadows, a few young trees, soft painted illustration. The library walls are plain brick with blank windows. The middle of the picture shows the open lot clearly. The lot is empty and quiet. No people, no animals, no writing, no signs.
